reason: Reproduced: Tab and Shift+Tab skip Show line chart, because the selected segment has tabindex=-1. But Enter on it changes nothing (same URL and chart), the other three segments are reachable, and once another mode is selected the line button is back in the tab order. Keyboard users lose no function.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 requires all functionality to be operable by keyboard. The only control Tab skips is the one for the mode already showing; activating it is a no-op, and switching to line chart by keyboard works from any other mode (Enter on Show overview chart made Show line chart focusable). 2.4.3 focus order stays logical (overview, stacked bar, sankey). 4.1.2 name and role are exposed (button "Show line chart"). That the selected mode is not announced is a different claim from this finding and was not evaluated here.
